ns2:course.label: Advanced Orbital Mechanics
ns2:course.description: (A A E 406) Circular restricted three body problem; surfaces of zero velocity, libration points, halo orbits; perturbed two body motion; Gauss and Lagrange planetary equations, Hamilton's principle, canonical equations and the Delaunay variables, application to artificial Earth satellites; orbit determination. Prerequisite: AE 402 or equivalent.
